query: Which analyses are primary vs exploratory, how will multiple outcomes be handled (estimation/CIs vs multiplicity correction), and what rules govern A/B test decisions?

response.query: Which analyses are primary vs exploratory, how will multiple outcomes be handled (estimation/CIs vs multiplicity correction), and what rules govern A/B test decisions?
response.answer: Primary analyses test main hypotheses; exploratory analyses investigate secondary questions. Multiple outcomes use multiplicity correction or separate confidence intervals. A/B tests use p-values to decide between control and treatment.
